_comment: Field validation - session-class evaluation across seven August 2026 runs. Binary performed-vs-detected decision per class per session; robust to memory-based annotation times. Sessions s1-s3: behavioural/anti-cheat scenarios. Sessions s4-s7: dedicated impersonation trials (a substitute sat in place of the enrolled student after a verified baseline; full-exit swap under 3s) - each trial contributes an IMPERSONATION-only decision by design scope; incidental HEAD_TURN/TAB flags during substitution settling (two fired before the swap completed, i.e. the enrolled student exiting) and the post-lock TAB_SWITCH are excluded from scoring and discussed qualitatively. Class mapping: TAB_HIDDEN merged into TAB_AWAY with TAB_SWITCH. Exclusions from scoring: ADMIN_UNLOCK rows, BLOCKED rows (lock outcome), 'verifying 1/3 & 2/3' pre-threshold moments, ABSENCE_MINOR kept as a deliberate false negative (performed >3s look-away, undetected). Impersonation ground truth corroborated by proctor_logs IMPERSONATION descriptions carrying face distances 0.59-0.66 vs the 0.55 threshold; time-to-lock 27.5s / 28.7s / 33.6s / 34.1s.
scenario: BlockProctor field validation - 7 sessions x violation classes
